description:
Reid Comfort SE ST | Step-through commuter bike
Comfortable, refined and built for effortless everyday riding – the ideal step-through commuter bike for commuting, getting around town and enjoying relaxed rides with premium comfort and control.
The Reid Bikes Comfort SE ST is designed to elevate your everyday cycling experience, combining a sophisticated low-step alloy frame with high-quality components for a smooth, comfortable and confidence-inspiring ride. Its relaxed geometry encourages an upright riding position, helping reduce fatigue while improving visibility in busy urban environments and on leisurely rides.
A lightweight rigid alloy fork keeps the bike responsive and easy to handle, while high-volume 2.4” tyres provide cushioning, grip and stability across roads, cycle paths and park promenades. The combination creates a comfortable, controlled ride for everything from daily errands to longer scenic journeys.
At the heart of the Comfort SE ST is a Shimano CUES 10-speed drivetrain featuring LinkGlide technology and a wide 11–48T gear range. Designed for smooth, durable shifting, it provides the versatility to tackle flat roads, hills and varied terrain with confidence. Tektro hydraulic disc brakes deliver powerful, consistent stopping performance in changing weather conditions, giving you greater control on everyday journeys.
Designed with comfort and convenience in mind, the Reid Bikes Comfort SE ST features an adjustable stem to help fine-tune your riding position, ergonomic grips for comfortable handling and a plush saddle for added support. Its low-step frame also makes mounting and dismounting easier, particularly when stopping frequently or riding in everyday clothing.
Combining premium components, thoughtful design and everyday versatility, the Reid Comfort SE offers a refined approach to hybrid cycling. Whether you're commuting, running errands or exploring local routes, it's built to make every ride smoother, more comfortable and more enjoyable.
The Reid Bikes Comfort SE ST is ideal for:

Everyday commuters, looking for a comfortable, premium bike for travelling to work and getting around town

Riders who value easy access, with a low-step alloy frame for convenient mounting and dismounting

Comfort-focused cyclists, with relaxed geometry, an adjustable stem, ergonomic grips and a plush saddle

Riders tackling hills and varied routes, with Shimano CUES 10-speed gearing and a wide 11–48T range

Smooth, durable gear changes, with Shimano LinkGlide technology designed for dependable everyday performance

Confident all-weather braking, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes for powerful, consistent stopping control

Cyclists exploring roads and cycle paths, with high-volume 2.4” tyres for cushioning, grip and stability

Riders seeking responsive handling, with a lightweight rigid alloy fork and a stable, upright riding position

Anyone looking for a premium everyday bike, combining quality components and comfort for commuting, errands and leisurely rides
